## Analytics

Ghif Lab uses Google Analytics to understand aggregate website traffic and improve the site. Google Analytics may collect information such as page views, approximate location, device type, and referral source.

No medical records, private documents, or user-submitted content are collected by this website.

## External services

Articles may link to external websites, repositories, media, and research papers. Those services have their own privacy policies and data practices.

For questions about this site or its data practices, contact [Muhammad Ghifary](mailto:mghifary@gmail.com).
